easyPrerequisites: You have a way to deal noncombat damage to Smaug.
description:
Deal noncombat damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating at least one Treasure token.
When the Treasure(s) enter as creature(s) due to March of the Machines, Pandemonium triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, dealing damage to Smaug.
Repeat from step 2.
